subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He is **blind from one eye**.
solution:
The correct answer is '**blind in one eye**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
__ 
 
• The phrase "**blind in one eye**" is the correct and standard usage in English. 
 
• It describes the condition of being unable to see with one eye. 
 
• **Options 1, 3, and 4** are grammatically incorrect and not commonly used in English. 
 
Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**. 
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He is blind in one eye."* 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 
 
 
• **Option 1: "blind with one eye"** is incorrect because the preposition "with" does not convey the intended meaning in this context. 
 
• **Option 3: "blind on one eye"** is incorrect as "on" is not the right preposition for this phrase. 
 
• **Option 4: "blind by one eye"** is incorrect because "by" is not used in this context.
